landing.badge: The #1 guide to moving to Italy
landing.heroSubtitle: Scared of Italian bureaucracy? We guide you step by step through everything you need to do: documents, residence, healthcare, bank and housing.
landing.problemTitle: Moving abroad is a bureaucratic nightmare
landing.problemSubtitle: We know what you're going through. Thousands of people like you face the same problems every day.
landing.pain1Desc: Forms, offices, deadlines. Nobody explains what to do and in what order.
landing.pain2Desc: You spend hours searching on Google, forums and Facebook groups without finding clear answers.
landing.pain3Desc: Wrong documents, useless queues, missed appointments. Every mistake costs time and money.
landing.pain4Desc: The fear of forgetting something important blocks you and makes you feel alone.
landing.solutionTitle2: A guide that holds your hand.
landing.solutionDesc: Trasferisciti tells you what to do, when to do it and how. No more confusion. Just clear steps toward your new life.
landing.feature1Desc: A step-by-step plan tailored to your situation. You always know what to do next.
landing.feature2Desc: Every document explained simply: what you need, where to go, how much it costs.
landing.feature3Desc: Ask questions and get answers from people who've been through it.
landing.step1Desc: We only need 2 minutes to understand your situation.
landing.step2Desc: A personalized plan with all the steps to follow.
landing.step3Desc: Follow the instructions and check off the list.
landing.step4Desc: Documents in order, life organized. You did it!
landing.useCasesSubtitle: Whether you come for work, study or family, we help you.
landing.ucWorkDesc: You found a job in Italy or are looking for a new professional opportunity.
landing.ucStudyDesc: You enrolled in an Italian university or want to study in Italy.
landing.ucFamilyDesc: You're reuniting with family or moving with your partner.
landing.finalCta: Ready to start your new life in Italy?
landing.finalCtaDesc: In 2 minutes we create your personalized journey. It's free.
landing.testimonial1: Without this guide I'd still be queuing at the wrong office. It saved me weeks of stress.
landing.testimonial2: Finally someone who explains Italian bureaucracy simply. Every step was clear.
landing.testimonial3: The community helped me so much. I found answers to questions I didn't even know I had.
